newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat edges up in two front months.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat edges up in two front months.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures were slightly higher in the two front months of December and March on Thursday amid slow farmer sales, traders said.
"The lack of country selling plus the (USDA quarterly grain stocks) report on Monday makes for a quiet market," one trader said.
He noted that locals were on both sides of the market but volume was thin. "I expect it (volume) to be thin for the next day ahead of the report," he said.
At 1011 CDT, MGE December spring wheat firmed 1/2 cent at $4.20-1/2 a bushel while the rest of the board was 1/2 cent lower to one cent higher.
MGE Dec barley futures lost two cents per hundredweight at $7.11.
